scope: Installed Chrome with an isolated synthetic profile and local HTTP fixture; standalone pinned CEF probe; no personal profile or Keychain secret extraction; no production feature changes.

browserAssertions: installed Chrome logs in and writes real localStorage/IndexedDB
the export contains HttpOnly session cookies unavailable to document.cookie
the source includes Secure host-prefixed and partitioned cookies
the destination starts without the Chrome login
semantic Cookie import restores server-side login without Chrome encryption keys
Cookie import alone does not transfer localStorage or IndexedDB
Cookie metadata, session flags, paths, HttpOnly, Secure and partition keys survive import
separate origin-scoped semantic storage import restores the fixture application state
imported persistent and session login cookies survive a real CEF process restart
imported localStorage and IndexedDB survive the destination restart

checks: the selected CEF profile stores all five imported cookies encrypted, with no plaintext values

evidence.originalTransferFailure: The final diagnostic selected empty Default/Cookies instead of the named destination profile. All 12 browser assertions had passed.

driverRepairs: Normalize argv using a one-argument path.resolve callback.
Bind Cookie operations to the exact page with Network.getCookies/setCookies; browser-target Storage context IDs are unsuitable for this CEF named profile.
Inspect Profile-migration explicitly rather than the global Default profile.
notTested: Real default Chrome-profile authorized export or companion extension
Real third-party accounts and device-bound sessions
Signed Release and real Chromium Keychain
Arbitrary IndexedDB types, cross-origin/partitioned site storage, Service Workers, Passkeys and browser sync
Product import UI or live profile sharing feature
